content: A crisis event involves providing care that includes assessing the immediate needs and concerns of the affected individual, ensuring that their basic physical needs are promptly met, offering or facilitating access to social support systems, and taking measures to protect them from further harm. A refugee is defined as an individual who, due to a well-founded fear of persecution based on factors such as race, religion, nationality, membership in a particular social group, political opinion, or due to external aggression, occupation, foreign domination, or events that severely disrupt public order in their country of origin or nationality, is forced to leave their habitual place of residence. This individual seeks refuge outside their country of origin or nationality and is either unable or, due to such fear, unwilling to avail themselves of the protection of their country of origin or nationality. Resilience refers to the ability of a system, community, or society that is potentially exposed to hazards to resist, adapt to, and recover from hazardous events. It also encompasses the capacity to restore an acceptable level of functioning and structural integrity following such events. Sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) encompasses acts that cause physical, mental, or sexual harm or suffering. This includes threats of such acts, coercion, and other forms of deprivation of liberty, targeting individuals or groups based on their gender. Sexual exploitation refers to the abuse of a position of vulnerability, differential power, or trust for sexual purposes. This includes deriving monetary, social, or political benefits from the sexual exploitation of another individual. Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) are a class of antidepressant medications that work by selectively inhibiting the reuptake of serotonin in the brain. Fluoxetine is an example of an SSRI. Tricyclic antidepressants (TCAs) are a class of antidepressant drugs that inhibit the reuptake of the neurotransmitters noradrenaline and serotonin. Amitriptyline is an example of a TCA.
